description: Frontend engineer role emphasizing React and TypeScript

input.jobDescription:
Frontend Engineer at StartupX

StartupX is revolutionizing B2B SaaS. We need a Frontend Engineer who cares deeply about user experience and code quality.

Responsibilities:
- Build responsive, accessible UI components in React
- Maintain and extend our TypeScript component library
- Write end-to-end tests with Cypress
- Collaborate with designers on Figma specs
- Optimize for Core Web Vitals

Required:
- 3+ years React experience
- TypeScript (strict mode)
- CSS/Tailwind CSS
- Jest and React Testing Library for unit tests
- Experience with Next.js or similar SSR framework

Desired:
- GraphQL and Apollo Client
- Storybook

Full-time, remote or hybrid in NYC. Email jobs@startupx.io to apply.
